_about: The Brothers Grimm (Jacob 1785-1863, Wilhelm 1786-1859), Kinder- und Hausmärchen, in Margaret Hunt's English translation (Household Tales, 1884, 2 vols, with Andrew Lang's introduction and the Grimms' own notes). Gutenberg's clean text of the tales plus the 1884 volumes as raw Internet Archive OCR, which carry Lang's introduction and the notes. Translator: Margaret Hunt (Mrs. Alfred William Hunt, 1831-1912). Other public-domain English Grimms are listed as pending alternates, not held. Published 1884: US public domain.
